mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to haulage costs relating to goods that this business has purchased and is responsible for transporting from the sellers' premises."

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the global organization supporting internal auditors."
The institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) is the global organization supporting internal auditors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential part of the build-up of overheads, because many indirect costs apply to numerous cost centres rather than just to one."
The process of apportionment is an essential part of the build-up of overheads, because many indirect costs apply to numerous cost centres rather than just to one.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the difference between the cost of the asset and the aggregate depreciation up to the date of disposal; that is, N1,000 - N657 = N343."
The WDV is the difference between the cost of the asset and the aggregate depreciation up to the date of disposal; that is, N1,000 - N657 = N343.

The gross profit is the difference between the two sides of the trading account and must be brought down to the opposite side of the account. 2.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the setting-aside of income to meet a known or highly probable future liability or loss, the amount and/or timing of which cannot be ascertained exactly, and is thus an estimate."
A provision is the setting-aside of income to meet a known or highly probable future liability or loss, the amount and/or timing of which cannot be ascertained exactly, and is thus an estimate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a more recent approach to product costing, pioneered by Professors Kaplan and Cooper of Harvard University."
ABC is a more recent approach to product costing, pioneered by Professors Kaplan and Cooper of Harvard University.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an estimate of the total amount of bad debts computed using a percentage (based on previous years' figures) of the trade receivables at the end of the current year."
A general provision is an estimate of the total amount of bad debts computed using a percentage (based on previous years' figures) of the trade receivables at the end of the current year.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an indication that cash is likely to be available whereas cash accounting shows exactly the cash that is available. d."
Profit is an indication that cash is likely to be available whereas cash accounting shows exactly the cash that is available. d.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a dealer in special traditional medicine for female piles."
Alaskan Enterprise is a dealer in special traditional medicine for female piles.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the amount allowed off the amount owed by a debtor to encourage the debtor to settle his debt within a stipulated period."
Cash discount is the amount allowed off the amount owed by a debtor to encourage the debtor to settle his debt within a stipulated period.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is described as 'on credit: The credit transaction with the storekeeper becomes a trade payable since he is now owes a debt of N30,000."
The arrangement is described as 'on credit: The credit transaction with the storekeeper becomes a trade payable since he is now owes a debt of N30,000.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a list of the balances in a general ledger at a specific time, divided between those with debit balances and those with credit balances."
A trial balance is a list of the balances in a general ledger at a specific time, divided between those with debit balances and those with credit balances.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the difference between the monetary amounts on the sides of an account."
The balance is the difference between the monetary amounts on the sides of an account.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is referred to as capital expenditure."
Money spent on non-current assets is referred to as capital expenditure.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a ledger account in the general ledger and thus part of the double-entry system."
The trading income account is a ledger account in the general ledger and thus part of the double-entry system.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the amount allowed off normal selling price at the time goods are being sold to encourage the customer to buy the goods or to buy in larger quantity than he would have done ordinarily."

Trade discount is the amount allowed off normal selling price at the time goods are being sold to encourage the customer to buy the goods or to buy in larger quantity than he would have done ordinarily.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the estimated proceeds of sale at the end of the asset's useful life to the business."
Residual value refers to the estimated proceeds of sale at the end of the asset's useful life to the business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the outcome of the evaluation or measurement of the subject matter, for example an entity's published environmental report."
The subject matter information is the outcome of the evaluation or measurement of the subject matter, for example an entity's published environmental report.
